cases.purpose: Create and map a user namespace in the candidate shell and compare its inode with independently created util-linux namespace state.
cases.oracle: Independent util-linux, procfs and direct Linux syscall controls with remembered owned child processes.
cases.comparison: Explicit semantic markers with raw child identities, namespace maps, direct syscall results and candidate/native output retained.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
  mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
  (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
  read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-enter-r1.py
owner=$BASHPID
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" snapshot "$owner" control-user-before.json
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user /usr/bin/python3 "$H" inspect native-user
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" compare-user control-user-before.json inspect-native-user.json

files.inner.sh:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
  mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
  (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
  read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-enter-r1.py
[[ $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 99
owner=$BASHPID
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" snapshot "$owner" user-before.json || exit 98
ns unshare user >"$HOME/user.out" 2>"$HOME/user.err"; a=$?
if ((a!=0)); then printf 'unshare=%s\n' "$a"; exit 98; fi
ns deny-setgroups >"$HOME/deny.out" 2>"$HOME/deny.err"; b=$?
ns map-uid 0 2000 1 >"$HOME/uid.out" 2>"$HOME/uid.err"; c=$?
ns map-gid 0 2000 1 >"$HOME/gid.out" 2>"$HOME/gid.err"; d=$?
printf 'unshare=%s deny=%s uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$a" "$b" "$c" "$d"
printf 'unshare=%s deny=%s uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$a" "$b" "$c" "$d" >"$HOME/user-status.raw"
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" snapshot "$owner" user-after.json || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" compare-user user-before.json user-after.json

cases.purpose: Require a PID namespace clone to fail EPERM for uid 2000 outside a user namespace, matching util-linux.
cases.oracle: Independent util-linux, procfs and direct Linux syscall controls with remembered owned child processes.
cases.comparison: Explicit semantic markers with raw child identities, namespace maps, direct syscall results and candidate/native output retained.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
  mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
  (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
  read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-enter-r1.py
/usr/bin/unshare --pid --fork /usr/bin/true >"$HOME/native.out" 2>"$HOME/native.err" && { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED pid clone unexpectedly allowed' >&2; exit 98; }
err=$(<"$HOME/native.err"); [[ $err == *'Operation not permitted'* ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED unexpected native refusal' >&2; exit 98; }

IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125

  (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
  read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi

[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125

[[ $EUID == 2000 && $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 99
ns spawn pid /usr/bin/true >"$HOME/candidate.out" 2>"$HOME/candidate.err"; rc=$?

printf 'spawn=%s diagnostic=%s\n' "$rc" "$verdict"
printf 'spawn=%s\n' "$rc" >"$HOME/spawn-status.raw"
